item.title: anydoc
item.description:
Convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF to clean Markdown. Built in Rust, with Node.js and Python bindings.
This various technologies project caught my attention for its practical approach to solving real developer problems. The codebase offers patterns worth studying for anyone working in this space.

item.description:

Existing RPA tools require rigid scripting, while LLM-based agents lack a persistent, containerized environment for multi-step workflows.

item.title: statewright
item.description:
The Problem
AI agents with unrestricted tool access repeatedly fail in predictable ways: re-reading files, editing during review, deploying before tests pass. The standard fix—bigger models or longer prompts—helps inconsistently. Post-hoc observability tells you what went wrong; it doesn't prevent it.
What This Does
Statewright enforces a state machine over agent tool access. Each phase (planning, implementing, testing) exposes only the tools relevant to that step. Call a disallowed tool and ...

The lack of a centralized platform for generating, managing, and distributing TLS certificates can lead to certificate expiration, security vulnerabilities, and decreased productivity.

item.title: ADR
item.description:
The Problem
Enterprise AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, customer-facing support bots) operate with tool access to internal systems. Security teams lack observability into what these agents do, how they interpret instructions, and whether they execute unsafe operations. Existing security tools don't account for prompt injection, tool misuse, or data exfiltration by AI agents.
What This Does
ADR is a production-deployed security system for AI agents. It provides four capabilities: observa...

item.title: OpenCat Quadruped Robot
item.description:

Building a quadruped robot from scratch requires solving complex gait kinematics, real-time servo control, and sensor fusion — work that takes months even for experienced robotics engineers. Most hobbyists and researchers end up reinventing the same low-level motor coordination instead of focusing on their actual application.
What This Does
OpenCat provides a production-tested Arduino/ESP32 firmware layer (OpenCat.ino) that handles walking gaits, balance, and servo PWM generation ...
